name: licensing-review-decisions
description: Produce structured JSON decisions for State licensing-board review tasks that read from a shared licensing-environment API and must conform exactly to a provided answer_template.json. Covers the three recurring task families: (A) contractor batch eligibility review, (B) restricted liquor-license staff package, (C) alcohol renewal manual-review queue. Use whenever a prompt casts you as a licensing examiner / renewal or staff reviewer, references a `<TASK_ENV_BASE_URL>` with `/api/...` endpoints, and asks for JSON matching `input/payloads/answer_template.json`.
